arxiv-1902-06285.title: Exploiting Unlabeled Data in CNNs by Self-supervised Learning to Rank
arxiv-1902-06285.creator: Xialei Liu, Joost van de Weijer, Andrew D. Bagdanov
arxiv-1902-06285.description: Abstract For many applications the collection of labeled data is expensive laborious. Exploitation of unlabeled data during training is thus a long pursued objective of machine learning. Self-supervised learning addresses this by positing an auxiliary task (different, but related to the supervised task) for which data is abundantly available.

arxiv-2108-06039.description: Abstract The Variables and Slow Transients Survey (VAST) on the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) is designed to detect highly variable and transient radio sources on timescales from 5 seconds to ∼ 5 \sim 5 years. In this paper, we present the survey description, observation strategy and initial results from the VAST Phase I Pilot Survey.

arxiv-2408-08375.title: Producing entangled photon pairs and quantum squeezed states in plasmas
arxiv-2408-08375.creator: Kenan Qu, Nathaniel J. Fisch
arxiv-2408-08375.description: Abstract Plasma is capable of mediating the conversion of two pump photons into two different photons through a relativistic four-wave mixing nonlinearity. Spontaneously created photon pairs are emitted at symmetric angles with respect to the colinear pump direction, and the emission rate is largest if they have identical frequency.

arxiv-2408-16750.title: Entanglement of Disjoint Intervals in Dual-Unitary Circuits: Exact Results
arxiv-2408-16750.creator: Alessandro Foligno, Bruno Bertini
arxiv-2408-16750.description: Abstract The growth of the entanglement between two disjoint intervals and its complement after a quantum quench is regarded as a dynamical chaos indicator. Namely, it is expected to show qualitatively different behaviours depending on whether the underlying microscopic dynamics is chaotic or integrable. So far, however, this could only be verified in the context of conformal field theories.

arxiv-2508-06790.title: Risk Aware Reservoir Control for Safer Urban Traffic Networks
arxiv-2508-06790.creator: Alexander Hammerl, Corresponding Author asiha@dtu.dk Wen-long Jin wjin@uci.edu Ravi Seshadri ravse@dtu.dk Thomas Kjær Rasmussen tkra@dtu.dk Otto Anker Nielsen oani@dtu.dk
arxiv-2508-06790.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander Hammerl, Corresponding Author asiha@dtu.dk Wen-long Jin wjin@uci.edu Ravi Seshadri ravse@dtu.dk Thomas Kjær Rasmussen tkra@dtu.dk Otto Anker Nielsen oani@dtu.dk. \AuthorHeaders

Hammerl, Jin, Seshadri, Rasmussen and Nielsen

1
Abstract

We present a risk-aware perimeter-style controller that couples safety and efficiency targets in large, heterogeneous urban traffic networks. The network is compressed into two interacting “reservoirs” whose dynamics follow the Generalized Bathtub Model, while accidents are described by a self-exciting (Hawkes) counting process whose intensity depends on vehicle exposure, speed dispersion between reservoirs and accident clustering.

pmc-12575420.creator: Paul F. Vollebregt, Coen I. M. Baeten, Asbjørn M. Drewes, Franco Marinello, Jacopo Martelluci, Mira Mekhael, Karen Nugent, Andreas D. Rink, Harald Rosen, S. Mark Scott, Peter Ernst Slattenschek, Frank Zerbib, Peter Christensen, The ADVISABLE Working Group
pmc-12575420.description: AimThe aims of the study were to: (1) update a systematic review on the efficacy of transanal irrigation (TAI) in patients with chronic constipation (CC) and/or faecal incontinence (FI); (2) provide guidance on the position of TAI in the treatment pathway of CC and FI; and (3) discuss knowledge gaps and areas of future research.

pmc-12603288.title: Systematic review and meta-analysis of the effectiveness of polypeptide, virus-like particles, and viral vector vaccines for foot-and-mouth disease (2020–2025)
pmc-12603288.creator: Alyaa Elrashedy, Walid Mousa, Mohamed Nayel, Akram Salama, Ahmed Zaghawa, Ahmed Elsify, Mohamed E Hasan
pmc-12603288.description: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) remains one of the most contagious viral diseases affecting livestock, posing major economic and food security challenges. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated recent advances in FMD vaccine strategies and their protective efficacy across platforms. The inclusion criteria were met by 24 out of 3,169 evaluated studies.

pmc-13449407.title: From linear models to deep learning: statistical advances in genomic selection for animal breeding
pmc-13449407.creator: Lifei Zhang, Mingzhu Zhang, Xinle Wang, Cancan Chen, Shunzhe Wang, Yujie Zhao, Yanjun Zhang, Ruijun Wang, Yongbin Liu
pmc-13449407.description: Genomic selection (GS) has revolutionized animal breeding by accelerating genetic gain through genome-wide marker data. As genotyping technologies advance and data dimensionality grows, the statistical foundations of GS are shifting from classical linear frameworks, which assume additive genetic effects, toward advanced computational models that capture complex nonlinear relationships in genomic data.

pmc-13518396.title: Energy metabolism in the kidney and its role in chronic kidney disease
pmc-13518396.creator: Hiroaki Kikuchi, Tomohiro Tsuboya, Jinming Hu, Mari Sugimoto, Miyu Yoshikawa, Maho Usui, Takefumi Suzuki, Mark A Knepper, Shinichi Uchida, Eisei Sohara
pmc-13518396.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with dysregulated lipid metabolism, particularly in proximal kidney tubules, where fatty acid oxidation serves as the primary energy source. The proximal tubules’ reliance on fatty acid oxidation rather than glycolysis underscores their unique metabolic profile, consistent with the absence of key glycolytic enzymes.
